works.body:
こんにちは！お元気ですか？
ぜひイラストのリクエストをさせていただきたいです！

こちらの2人のキャラクターを描いていただけたら嬉しいです！
https://www.deviantart.com/stash/226ng420eufd

2人はとっても仲良しの親友で、森の中の廃屋で出会いました！🏚️🌲一緒に楽しい遊びをするのが大好きなんです！

どんな風に描いていただいても大歓迎です！
ご検討いただけましたら嬉しいです。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします！

Hi sensei, I’m a big fan of your spooky art and your backgrounds, and would like to request an illustration of my original characters! 

They are Elliot and Clandestina. Elliot is a painter and Clandestina is the painting which came alive that he fell in love with. 

Elliot: He is 184cm and has an apathetic personality. He is very famous for still-life paintings but struggles to draw people with emotion. A girl in white (Clandestina) appeared to him in a dream, so he painted her on canvas and she came to life. 

Clandestina: She is 164 cm. Mysterious girl in the painting. She seems sweet but is actually very manipulative. She can move between different paintings but can not fully leave the frame. 

Their themes are paintings, easels, and purple flowers! The concept is dark and Victorian. You can change some parts of the outfits if it is unclear, or add extra accessories if you think it would look nice. 

Please paint freely, and thank you so much for considering my request! ❤️

https://toyhou.se/21757845.clandestina/gallery

Hello sensei! I always love your art! Can I request two original characters?

1. Pyrite: https://toyhou.se/33236200.pyrite
A sharp assassin who operates in the shadows. Prefers solitude. Beneath it all, she hides a deep sense of resignation.
Motifs: Death symbolized through birds (black birds such as black swans, crows), feathers, skeleton flowers (blue taint)

2. Tao: https://toyhou.se/34426527.tao
A mysterious wanderer who appears and disappears like the wind.
Before you see him, you hear the sound of his pipa coming from nowhere

He has a calm, curious, easygoing, and lighthearted personality.
Motifs: Lotus flower, reincarnation, detachment from the world, a pure vessel that sings of life

Relationship:
Somewhere between friendship and companionship, a relationship in which they do not dislike each other's presence. Tao often plays music whenever he sees Pyrite, inquiring her about her recent happenings. She offers guarded responses. Interpret freely, please draw them as you please!

I also attached a picture sample for the background but you can freely design it!

If you could, I would love to have two versions of him (one with mask and one without mask! The mask will be added to the link soon~). But it is up to you to let him wear the mask or not.

Thank you so much for the consideration. If the amount is not suitable, please adjust it!

Hello, thank you for looking at my request! 

I would like a Halloween themed illustration of the character's witch outfit. I plan to use it as a birthday picture and post to SNS. The illustration will be clearly credited to Hackto.

The character is a fae dullahan, but does not remove their head. It looks like a knight but is temporarily dressed as a witch. The weapon is not required. Please adjust the price if needed. 

The overall request is a Halloween party in a dark fae forest. It is a fun environment.
Please include pumpkins and lights.
Please draw many of the 'gazer' in the image with them. They are very small like bugs.
Everything else is up to you!

Please use one of the outfits from the folder or design your own.

Traveling vampire hunter
180 cm. Blond male. Very skinny.
Talkative, mischievous, and sly personality.

Gabe
Vampire

Despite being a vampire, Alois is fond of Gabe. They travel together to fight monsters and vampires.

Hello again! I’d like to request another couple!
https://www.deviantart.com/stash/21ake0li2ic4
 
- A tired older man who is a clockmaker and inventor. He is stoic and serious, but he is nice to his maid. He has a monocle with a clock on it and has clockwork motifs in his outfit.
- A maid who is an assistant the clockmaker. She is actually the spirit of a cuckoo clock that came to life! She is soft-spoken, cheerful, very curious, and very clumsy. She loves following the clockmaker around!
- Their story is that one day the clockmaker makes a cuckoo clock and mysteriously disappears. The cuckoo clock turns into a young woman and goes out searching for him! They eventually reunite and live in an old clock tower.
- Their motifs are owls, clocks, nature, books, gears/tools, ballroom dancing.

Please draw any scene you’d like! For some ideas, you can draw them inside or outside a clock tower or in the man’s workshop.

Please appeal if the amount is not enough. Thank you for reading!

Hackto🎃様

初めまして、リクエスト失礼致します！ 
先生の作品がすごく好きです、もしよろしければオリキャラ二人のイラストを描いていただきたいです。

【F/フィデリア】 - 灰金髪/オッドアイ（青/白）/無愛想
【W/ウィンストン】- 黄髪/赤い目/快楽主義者
キャラクターの詳細な設定については、こちらのURLからご確認いただければと思います。複数パロと衣装があるのですが資料の中からご自由に選んでいただいて構いません。衣装は変更可能！
キャラクターの印象や関係性に基づいて、自由に描いていただければと思います。

可能であれば納品はPSD・宛名などは別レイヤーでお願いします。没ラフや下描きなどがあれば残したままにしていただけると嬉しいです。依頼内容等に何か問題があれば、遠慮なくお断りください。

依頼を読んでいただき、ありがとうございました...！ご検討よろしくお願いします。

Posting on social networking sites

You may also make your own arrangements.

Nice to meet you, excuse my request.

Could you please illustrate two original characters?

Main Idea: I would like to see the two characters exploring each other, knowing that they are both bounty hunters, and playing tense games with each other, while still maintaining an atmosphere of ambiguous affection.
Sub (if it fits your request): A situation in which they spend time together like a normal couple, but with a slightly sweet atmosphere is also acceptable.

Costume

You may choose any of the outfits in the URLs below.
You are also welcome to design your own.

Composition and poses

There are no detailed specifications, so we leave it up to your sense of style.

About the data to be delivered

We would appreciate it if you could provide us with the following formats.
Transparent PNG or PSD file (characters only)
PSD file with a PSD layer that can be switched between the address "Yao" and the signature.

Applications
SNS icons and headers
Printing for personal use

If the reference image is unclear, or if there is no explanation as to which image should be used as a reference, you are free to draw freely.
If it is deemed inappropriate, you are free to cancel this request.
　　We apologize for any rudeness. Thank you for your cooperation. ＞＜Thank you very much for your cooperation.

We were hoping you could draw a scene where Kasper is excitedly showing Luka around a festival!

Kasper (Human): https://sta.sh/2p03ccro892
Kasper is a very outgoing lovable guy. He goes ahead doing things without thinking with a big smile on his face. He can get flustered when he's put on the spot or when he's ignorant on something. He never gets genuinely mad at Luka's pranks and goes with the flow. Kasper loves dragging Luka around when he can. He is taller than Luka.

Luka (Ghost): https://sta.sh/2o7ofrcr7ng
Luka is mischievous and loves pulling pranks on people especially Kasper. Kasper is the only one who can see him. He can become a bit of a tsundere when faced with Kasper's bright attitude! He's use to being alone so he's not use to any kind of affection but will eventually accept it.

They both love each other very much!

Besides the festival scene we leave the rest to you! Thank you!

Hello, I'm a newcomer to this site! I am sending you a request to draw the two protagonists of a TRPG scenario of your own creation, if possible.

Here are the details.
▼ Lila Sullivan.
Special Agent at Scotland Yard. She is a blonde woman with a penchant for wearing men's clothes and is cheerful and good-natured.
In reality, she is a serial killer, and although this time she is on Frederick's side until the end, she is a disquieting element who could be the mastermind or the last boss at any moment. She is Watson, Moriarty, and Irene Adler.

Height-171cm
Age-24
Strengths-Lying, acting, quick hands, drug development

▼ Frederick MacPhail.
Psychiatrist and Scotland Yard's only consulting detective. A dusky blond-haired man with a pipe. Expressionless and rather taciturn, always calm, a cold monster who thinks he is a sensible man.
One day, he begins to suffer from hallucinations in which he sees people's faces as monsters, but by pursuing the mystery of a case brought to him by Lila, he is able to get closer to the true nature of his hallucinations.

Height-186cm
Age-34 years old
Areas of expertise - reasoning, persuasion, counseling

▼ About Requests

Worldview-London in the late 19th century. The system is set in the Cthulhu Mythos TRPG, and the mastermind may also be a monster or an inhuman creature. There is mystery, detective, and English romance.

Hope - I would be happy to draw as you wish without being bound by the material! It's also fine to ignore all excerpts from the book and other material in the drawings and materials. I will leave it to you to handle.
I love your comfortable compositions, exciting colors, and stylish compositions, so I would be very happy if you could freely draw the requested materials and character details as if they were an accessory.
